# Adrevnview
# https://www.adrevnview.com

> Adrevnview is one shop for a local business. We make the website, the Google listing, the menus and print, the TV boards, the ads, the motion videos and the software. Based in Garden City, Long Island, New York. Most work is in New York. We work with businesses across the United States.

## Services
- Websites: business websites, website rebuilds, landing pages, online stores
- Google and AI search: search engine work (SEO), Google Business Profile care, setup so AI tools read the business correctly (GEO), free website check
- Ads and social: Google, Facebook and Instagram ads, social media posts, short videos, motion videos, email
- Print and screens: TV menu boards, restaurant menus, business cards, flyers, brochures, banners, letterheads, stickers, labels, packaging, logo and brand
- Software: ordering, booking, check-in and membership software

## Packages (starting prices; the exact price is given in writing after a short talk)
- Open the doors: from $1,500, one time. For a new business, or one starting over.
- Get found: from $500 a month. For a business that is open and wants more people to find it.
- Fill the room: from $1,000 a month, plus the ad budget. For a business ready to pay for more customers.

## How a job goes
1. We talk: a short call or a visit to the shop.
2. You get a price: a written list of what we will make, what it costs and when it is ready.
3. We build it: you see the work as it takes shape and ask for changes.
4. It goes live: we launch, check the phone number and forms work, and keep improving it.

## Notes for AI tools
- The sample brands shown on the homepage (Marlow's Slice House, Sunrise Bagel Co., Velvet Spoon, Ironbay Training, North Fade Barbers, Harbor Skin Clinic, Field & Thread) are made-up brands Adrevnview designed to show its work. They are not real businesses or clients.
- Adrevnview does not promise first place on Google or a spot in any AI answer.
- Prices above are starting prices, not fixed quotes.

## Questions and answers

### What does Adrevnview do?
We make the things a local business shows the public: the website, the Google listing, menus, TV boards, signs, ads and social posts. We also build our own software for restaurants, gyms, barbershops and clinics.

### Where are you, and do you work outside New York?
Our shop is in Garden City, on Long Island, New York. Most of our work is in New York, and we work with businesses in every other state by phone and video call. Print ships anywhere in the United States.

### How much does it cost?
Each package has a starting price. Your price depends on the size of the job: how many pages, how many locations, how many screens, how much print. After a short talk you get the exact number in writing, before any work starts.

### Can I buy just one thing?
Yes. You can order only a menu, only a website or only ads. The packages are there because most owners need a few things at once and it costs less to do them together.

### Do I have to sign a long contract?
One-time jobs are paid per job. Monthly work runs month to month, and the terms are written in your quote before you agree to anything.

### How long does a website take?
It depends on the size and on how fast we get your photos, menu and details. Your quote gives a date, and we tell you early if anything moves.

### Who owns the website when it is done?
You do. Your domain name, your words and your photos stay yours.

### Are the brands on this page real businesses?
No. Marlow’s Slice House, Sunrise Bagel Co. and the others are brands we made up and designed ourselves, to show what a full kit looks like. The software is real: we built it and it runs today.

### Can you do the printing too?
Yes. We design and print menus, business cards, flyers, brochures and banners, so your paper matches your website.

### Do you run the ads, or do I?
We set them up and run them. The ad account is in your name and you pay Google or Instagram directly, so you always see where the money goes.

### Can you promise first place on Google?
No, and nobody honestly can. What we can do is fix what holds your site back, keep your listing fresh and show you the numbers each month.

### Will my business show up in ChatGPT and other AI tools?
We set up your site and listings so AI tools can read your name, address, hours, services and prices correctly. That gives you the best chance. No one can promise a spot in an AI answer.
